 Medicare open enrollment continues through Dec. 7 
 By ohtadmin 
 on 
 October 28, 2026 
 Medicare beneficiaries have until Dec. 7 to review their health and prescription drug coverage and make changes for 2027. During the annual Open Enrollment Period, beneficiaries may switch between Original Medicare and Medicare Advantage, change Medicare Advantage plans or join, drop or switch Part D prescription drug plans. Changes take effect Jan. 1, 2027. Beneficiaries are encouraged to review notices […]
